text: Implemented public noise_precision() and crossnobis() as a validating query-first view over the existing geometry compiler. It requires an explicit fixed noise precision and independent cross-partition edges. Product tests cover direct base-R oracle agreement, raw-response versus precomputed-effect equivalence under an explicit observation whitener, additive versus support-streamed lowerings on point supports, signed negative retention, scaling and permutation gauge laws, near-singular precision, domain/metric/pairing refusals, and a prespecified 64-replication null/planted recovery gate. Focused suite passes.
